content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: High 5xx rate for tenant StormBridge (enterprise, VPC) in eu-west-1. Error spike started ~00:06 UTC. Paging on-call.
ryan: I’m on it. Reproducing now. Can someone paste the tenant_id and pool id? @support-liu?
support-liu: stormbridge-tenant-id: sb-9142, dedicated-pool: dp-euwest-02. Customer-report: high latency + partial inference timeouts since ~00:05. They see ~25% failures on production traffic.
maria: Looking at metrics — queue depth on dp-euwest-02 is high, GPU utilization at 98%, OOM-ish errors in runtime logs. KV-cache evictions spiking.
jess: Could be model hot-shard causing contention. Any recent deploys to that pool? @deploy-bot logs?
deploy-bot: Deploy event: 1832003600 - artifacts/llama-13b:v3 -> dp-euwest-02. No rollbacks.
sre-nico: I’ll tail the node logs. Pushing a temporary increase to autoscaler params for the pool to see if we can buy time.
eng-maya: Suggest preparing a regional failover plan to us-west-1 (warm capacity available in dp-uswest-01). If autoscaler can’t catch up we should shift traffic to prevent customer outage.
ryan: Agreed. Initial mitigation: increase pool replicas by +2 and increase queue limit. Maria, coordinate with autoscaler. Jess, prepare model fallback (quantized variant) for reduced memory.
maria: Hitting the autoscaler API now:

```
POST /internal/autoscaler/pools/dp-euwest-02/scale
{ "delta_replicas": 2, "max_replicas": 12 }
```

maria: Request accepted. New target replicas 10 -> scaling up.
sre-nico: Logs show repeated kernel OOM at 00:07:13 on node euw-03. Might be a model cache bug. If scaling doesn't stabilize, we do traffic shift.
support-liu: Notifying StormBridge support contact that we’re investigating and may perform controlled regional failover. ETA 15m for next update.
ryan: Prep DNS plan. We have a low-TTL alias stormbridge.prod.redwood.net -> edgedns record pointing to eu-west pool targets. Plan: update alias to point at us-west load targets and do a graceful cutover with canary weight 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
jess: Canary files ready. Also have quantized fallback model 'llama-13b-q3' staged in dp-uswest-01.
eng-maya: Warm pool check: dp-uswest-01 has 4 idle replicas with model cached and health OK. We need to increase to match expected throughput from StormBridge (estimated peak qps 350). Starting warm-up with prefix caching to seed KV caches.
ryan: Steps (short):
- 00:12 Start warm-up in us-west: ensure model and KV caches seeded.
- 00:18 DNS canary 10% -> monitor errors/latency 5m windows.
- 00:30 escalate to 50% if stable.
- 00:40 full shift if stable.
- rollback plan: revert DNS alias and drain new nodes.

sre-nico: Executing warm-up script:

```
./tools/warm_pool --pool dp-uswest-01 --tenant sb-9142 --concurrency 50 --duration 600
```

deploy-bot: Warm-up job started (job-id 9a7c). Progress: 0/600s.
maria: KVS prefetch hit rate increasing. Memory usage on dp-uswest-01 nodes rising to expected levels.
support-liu: Customer msg: "Thanks, appreciate the proactive approach. We'll monitor." They asked for timing — told them ~30-40m for full cutover depending on stability.
jess: Preparing DNS update snippet (internal):

```
# set canary weight to 10%
PUT /internal/traffic-router/aliases/stormbridge.prod/redwood
{ "weights": { "euwest": 90, "uswest": 10 }, "ttl": 30 }
```

ryan: Before changing weights run a quick smoke against the canary targets.

```
curl -sS https://uswest-edge-01.internal/healthz && curl -sS https://uswest-edge-02.internal/healthz
# then sample inference request
POST https://uswest-edge-01.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck","max_tokens":8}'
```

sre-nico: Health checks pass. Latency acceptable (~60ms p50). Starting canary DNS update to 10% now.
maria: Canary set. Monitor: errors for tenant down from 25% -> 18% overall. On us-west path errors ~2% (initial). Good signs.
jess: Also enabling model-fallback path on eu-west nodes to redirect requests that fail due to OOM to a lighter variant. Patch applied.
ryan: Set alerts tighter for canary: if errors > 5% on us-west canary, roll back to eu-west immediately and notify.
support-liu: Customer notified of canary start.
eng-maya: After 10m monitoring window things look good. Traffic weight -> 50% now.

maria: Observability: token cost, latency, error-rate trending improving. dp-euwest-02 still under pressure but not critical.
sre-nico: Scaling completed on eu-west nodes; some nodes still OOMing sporadically. Recommend draining eu-west after we hit 100% shift.
ryan: Continue 5m monitoring windows. If pain reduced we proceed to full cutover at 00:40.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed: 10% -> 50% -> now 85%.

support-liu: Customer reports no visible user impact in their dashboards. They asked for a postmortem once stable.
jess: Now flipping final weight to 100% and updating aliases.

maria: Final set completed. dp-uswest-01 handling 100% of StormBridge traffic. Error rate on tenant dropped from 25% -> 1.2%. Latency stable.
ryan: Marking incident mitigated. Next: schedule a rolling drain of dp-euwest-02, collect logs and core dumps, prepare RCA.
sre-nico: Snapshotting node logs and heap dumps. Starting deeper analysis for kernel OOM patterns.

support-liu: Notifying customer: full failover complete. Offering scheduled follow-up call. They asked about timeline to return traffic — we'll wait for RCA and patch before any reverse shift.
eng-maya: Create immediate postmortem ticket and link to this thread. Assign to SRE and Runtime teams.

ryan: Handoff to night oncall @maria for monitoring and RCA follow-ups. I will remain available until handoff complete.
maria: Taking oncall. I'll own postmortem draft and timeline. Thanks everyone.

incident-bot: Incident severity: P1 -> mitigated. Duration: ~00:06 - 00:40 UTC. Actions: warm pool failover to dp-uswest-01, autoscaler adjustments, model-fallback enabled, eu-west pool drain pending.

ryan: Closing live coordination. Please add any stray notes; I'll finalize the timeline and tags in the incident ticket."
